sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Views4You ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our services.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We may collect personal information that you provide to us, including but not limited to: Name and contact information (email address, phone number), Payment information (processed securely through third-party payment processors), Account credentials, Order history and transaction details. We automatically collect certain information about your device and how you interact with our website, including: IP address and browser type, Pages visited and time spent on pages, Referring website addresses, Device information.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to:
listItems: Process and fulfill your orders
Provide customer support and respond to inquiries
Send you updates about your orders and account
Improve our website and services
Detect and prevent fraud or abuse
Comply with legal obligations
Send marketing communications (with your consent)

sections.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosure
sections.body: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
listItems: Service Providers: We may share information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website and conducting our business.
Legal Requirements: We may disclose information if required by law or in response to valid legal requests.
Business Transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred.
With Your Consent: We may share information with your explicit consent.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information, including:
listItems: The right to access your personal information
The right to rectify inaccurate information
The right to request deletion of your information
The right to object to processing of your information
The right to data portability
The right to withdraw consent

sections.heading: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
sections.body: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our website and store certain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent.

sections.heading: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our Contact Us page.

sections.heading: Agreement to Terms
sections.body: By accessing and using Views4You's website and services, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

subsections.body: You must be at least 18 years old to use our services. By using our services, you represent and warrant that you are of legal age to form a binding contract.

You may be required to create an account to access certain features. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.
You agree not to use our services:
listItems: For any unlawful purpose or to solicit others to perform unlawful acts
To violate any international, federal, provincial, or state regulations, rules, laws, or local ordinances
To infringe upon or violate our intellectual property rights or the intellectual property rights of others
To harass, abuse, insult, harm, defame, slander, disparage, intimidate, or discriminate
To submit false or misleading information
To upload or transmit viruses or any other type of malicious code

sections.heading: Service Description
sections.body: Views4You provides social media growth services including but not limited to YouTube views, subscribers, likes, TikTok followers, Google Ads views, and Google Reviews. We strive to provide high-quality services, but we do not guarantee specific results or outcomes.

sections.heading: Payment Terms
sections.body: Payment: All payments must be made in advance. We accept various payment methods as displayed on our website. Pricing: Prices are subject to change without notice. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue any service at any time. Refunds: Refund policies are outlined in our Refund Policy. Please review it before making a purchase.

sections.heading: Service Delivery
sections.body: Delivery times vary depending on the service and package selected. While we strive to meet estimated delivery times, we do not guarantee specific delivery schedules. All services are delivered gradually to ensure natural growth patterns.

sections.heading: Refill Guarantee
sections.body: We offer a refill guarantee on eligible services. If you experience drops in engagement within the guarantee period, we will refill the service at no additional cost, subject to our Refund Policy terms.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: The website and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by Views4You and are protected by international copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, and other intellectual property laws.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: In no event shall Views4You, its directors, employees, or agents be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including without limitation, loss of profits, data, use, goodwill, or other intangible losses, resulting from your use of our services.

sections.heading: Indemnification
sections.body: You agree to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Views4You and its officers, directors, employees, and agents from and against any claims, liabilities, damages, losses, and expenses, including reasonable attorney's fees, arising out of or in any way connected with your use of our services or violation of these Terms.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: We may terminate or suspend your account and access to our services immediately, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.

sections.heading: Changes to Terms
sections.body: We reserve the right to modify or replace these Terms at any time. If a revision is material, we will provide at least 30 days notice prior to any new terms taking effect.

sections.heading: Contact Information
sections.body: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us through our Contact Us page.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: At Views4You, we strive to provide the best possible service to our customers. This Refund Policy outlines the circumstances under which refunds may be issued and the process for requesting a refund.

subsections.body: If we fail to deliver the service within the specified delivery timeframe and you have not received any portion of the service, you may be eligible for a full refund.

If you experience significant issues with the delivered service (such as drops exceeding our guarantee threshold), we will first attempt to resolve the issue through our refill guarantee. If a refill is not possible or does not resolve the issue, a refund may be considered.
If you accidentally place a duplicate order, please contact us within 24 hours of placing the order. We will process a full refund for the duplicate order.
If you cancel your order before service delivery has begun, you may be eligible for a refund, subject to a processing fee.

sections.heading: Non-Refundable Situations
sections.body: Refunds will not be issued in the following circumstances:
listItems: If the service has been fully or partially delivered
If you violate our Terms of Service
If you provide incorrect information (such as wrong video URL, account username, etc.)
If you request a refund after the service has been completed successfully
If the service drops are within normal parameters and covered by our refill guarantee
If you change your mind after placing an order and the service has started

subsections.body: Submit a refund request through our Contact Us page or by emailing our support team. Include your order number and a detailed explanation of why you are requesting a refund.
Our support team will review your request within 24-48 hours. We may request additional information or evidence to process your refund request.
If your refund request is approved, we will process the refund to your original payment method within 5-10 business days.

sections.heading: Refund Methods
sections.body: Refunds will be issued to the original payment method used for the purchase. The time it takes for the refund to appear in your account depends on your payment provider and may take up to 10 business days.

sections.heading: Refill Guarantee vs. Refund
sections.body: For eligible services, we offer a refill guarantee. If you experience drops in engagement, we will first attempt to refill the service at no additional cost. Refunds are only considered if refills are not possible or do not resolve the issue satisfactorily.

sections.heading: Partial Refunds
sections.body: In some cases, we may issue a partial refund if only a portion of the service was delivered or if there were issues with part of the order. The refund amount will be proportional to the undelivered or problematic portion of the service.

sections.heading: Processing Fees
sections.body: Some refund requests may be subject to a processing fee, particularly for cancellations made after service delivery has begun. Any applicable fees will be clearly communicated before processing the refund.

sections.heading: Dispute Resolution
sections.body: If you are not satisfied with our refund decision, please contact us to discuss your concerns. We are committed to finding a fair resolution for all parties involved.

sections.heading: Changes to Refund Policy
sections.body: We reserve the right to modify this Refund Policy at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting to this page. Your continued use of our services after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the modified policy.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Refund Policy or need to request a refund, please contact us through our Contact Us page.

sections.heading: What Are Cookies?
sections.body: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and understanding how you use our site.

sections.heading: Manage Your Preferences
sections.body: You can customize which cookies we use below. Essential cookies are required for the website to function and cannot be disabled.

sections.heading: Browser Settings
sections.body: You can also manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse or accept cookies. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website. For more information about how we use cookies, please see our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us through our Contact Us page.

cookieTypes.name: Essential Cookies
cookieTypes.description: Required for the website to function. These include security, session management, and load balancing.

cookieTypes.name: Analytics Cookies
cookieTypes.description: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting anonymous information.

cookieTypes.name: Marketing Cookies
cookieTypes.description: Used to deliver relevant advertisements and track ad campaign performance.
